_doc: Registry of the Fin-CM project (Fin-CM, master index). A SUBSET of repo_master/repos.json (git-repos-master), narrowed to Fin-CM repo family (company sites and finance projects). Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container - see clone.sh for the clone/link model. Private members are linked only: the index exposes their name, never their content.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.
